title: cinnamomum johnstonii
intro: Cinnamomum johnstonii, commonly known as West Indian cinnamon or Indian bay, is a plant species in the family Lauraceae. This plant is valued for its essential oil, which has been used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation and relief from stress. The health benefits of Cinnamomum johnstonii include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, while its therapeutic actions include sedative and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include eugenol, linalool, and beta-caryophyllene, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
